simtune:
usage: simtune [-h] [--version]
               {doctor,list-modes,profile,run,compare,show,import-profile,tune,explain,exec,validate} ...

Inspect, profile, and tune command workloads

positional arguments:
  {doctor,list-modes,profile,run,compare,show,import-profile,tune,explain,exec,validate}
    doctor              Inspect platform capabilities
    list-modes          List available tuning profiles
    profile             Run baseline profiling
    run                 Run with tuning profile
    compare             Compare run directories
    show                Inspect a saved experiment or legacy run
    import-profile      Import external perf stat diagnostics
    tune                Measure strict candidates with a bounded search
    explain             Explain recipe evidence and applicability
    exec                Replay a compatible recipe exactly once
    validate            Revalidate a recipe with fresh checked pairs

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
doctor:
usage: simtune doctor [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
list-modes:
usage: simtune list-modes [-h] [--profiles PATH]

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --profiles PATH  Custom YAML file (repeatable)
profile:
usage: simtune profile [-h] --out OUT [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--repeat REPEAT]
                       [--dry-run]
                       ...

positional arguments:
  cmd

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --out OUT          Output directory for run data
  --timeout TIMEOUT  Timeout in seconds
  --repeat REPEAT    Repeat count
  --dry-run          Show plan without executing
run:
usage: simtune run [-h] --out OUT [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--repeat REPEAT]
                   [--dry-run] --mode MODE [--latency-important]
                   [--respect-desktop] [--notify] [--profiles PATH]
                   ...

positional arguments:
  cmd

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --out OUT            Output directory for run data
  --timeout TIMEOUT    Timeout in seconds
  --repeat REPEAT      Repeat count
  --dry-run            Show plan without executing
  --mode MODE          Profile name or 'auto'
  --latency-important  Prefer latency mode
  --respect-desktop    Prefer desktop friendly mode
  --notify             Send a desktop notification when done
  --profiles PATH      Custom YAML file (repeatable)
compare:
usage: simtune compare [-h] [--out OUT] run_dirs [run_dirs ...]

positional arguments:
  run_dirs    Run directories to compare

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --out OUT   Directory for comparison exports (default: current directory)
show:
usage: simtune show [-h] [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR] [--json] run

positional arguments:
  run                  Exact directory or unique ID prefix

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR  Directory searched for IDs (default: runs)
  --json
import-profile:
usage: simtune import-profile [-h] --format {perf-stat} --input INPUT
                              --context CONTEXT --out OUT

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {perf-stat}
  --input INPUT         UTF-8 perf stat -x ';' output
  --context CONTEXT     Versioned JSON measurement context
  --out OUT             New import directory
tune:
usage: simtune tune [-h] [--workload WORKLOAD] [--config CONFIG]
                    [--show-config] [--json] [--label LABEL] [--budget BUDGET]
                    [--out OUT] [--save SAVE] [--resume EXPERIMENT_DIR]
                    [--repeat REPEAT] [--warmups WARMUPS] [--seed SEED]
                    [--confirmation-pairs CONFIRMATION_PAIRS]
                    [--confirmation-fraction CONFIRMATION_FRACTION]
                    [--minimum-improvement MINIMUM_IMPROVEMENT]
                    [--max-trials MAX_TRIALS] [--max-launches MAX_LAUNCHES]
                    [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--from-run FROM_RUN]
                    [--collectors {timing,perf-stat}] [--dry-run]
                    ...

positional arguments:
  cmd

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --workload WORKLOAD   Strict TOML/JSON workload with scientific checks
  --config CONFIG       Explicit TOML config (default: ./simtune.toml if
                        present)
  --show-config         Show effective tuning options and sources
  --json                Emit one JSON result on stdout
  --label LABEL         Safe label for the default run ID
  --budget BUDGET       Total tuning time (e.g. 30s, 10m); additional time on
                        resume
  --out OUT             New experiment directory
  --save SAVE           Save a new explainable recipe and its evidence bundle
  --resume EXPERIMENT_DIR
                        Continue only never-started work using unspent
                        authorization
  --repeat REPEAT       Exploration pairs per case/candidate (default: 3)
  --warmups WARMUPS     Warmup pairs per training case/candidate (default: 1)
  --seed SEED           Schedule and bootstrap seed (default: 0)
  --confirmation-pairs CONFIRMATION_PAIRS
                        Fresh held-out pairs per case (minimum: 5)
  --confirmation-fraction CONFIRMATION_FRACTION
                        Time reserved for confirmation (default: 0.5)
  --minimum-improvement MINIMUM_IMPROVEMENT
                        Required relative time reduction (default: 0.02)
  --max-trials MAX_TRIALS
                        Lower trial cap; manifest limit remains a ceiling
  --max-launches MAX_LAUNCHES
                        Lower subprocess cap, including validators and hooks
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Bare-command trial timeout (default: 60s)
  --from-run FROM_RUN   Existing or imported profile as identity-checked hints
                        only
  --collectors {timing,perf-stat}
                        Optional trial diagnostics (default: timing, no
                        external tool)
  --dry-run             Show protocol; launch no processes and create no
                        evidence directory
explain:
usage: simtune explain [-h] [--json] [--workload WORKLOAD] recipe

positional arguments:
  recipe

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --json
  --workload WORKLOAD  Check this manifest and the current resources without
                       launching
exec:
usage: simtune exec [-h] --recipe RECIPE [--allow-unvalidated]
                    [--workload WORKLOAD] [--case CASE] [--out OUT]
                    [--cwd CWD] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--dry-run]
                    ...

positional arguments:
  cmd

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --recipe RECIPE
  --allow-unvalidated
  --workload WORKLOAD  Declare permitted new case values/input
                       identity/runtime
  --case CASE          Disambiguate a declared case ID
  --out OUT            New replay log directory (default: .simtune/replays/ID)
  --cwd CWD            Workload working directory (default: current directory)
  --timeout TIMEOUT    Lower the saved workload timeout
  --dry-run
validate:
usage: simtune validate [-h] --recipe RECIPE --workload WORKLOAD --out OUT
                        [--budget BUDGET] [--dry-run]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --recipe RECIPE
  --workload WORKLOAD
  --out OUT            New experiment directory; derived recipe is
                       DIR.recipe.json
  --budget BUDGET      Total validation budget (default: 10m)
  --dry-run
